data.description:
## Context / Problem

Legacy CLI and direct-engine `reconcile` modes still retain defaults, `--filter-local-ids`, exit values, manifest/tally output, and `reconcile-check` persisted state. The canonical bridge diagnostic migration is delivered by nosy-drooly-milksnake [rebar:nosy-drooly-milksnake].

## Approach

After that prerequisite is complete, remove all legacy CLI registrations and direct-engine mode values, including `Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK`. Migrate historical `"reconcile-check"` state or retain a narrow read decoder until it is safe to retire. Preserve live lock-loss `ReconcileLockLost -> RESCHEDULE`, canonical bridge exit 0, `snapshot_head` drift checks, and store `RebaseGuard` exit 75.

## Scope

- CLI registry/dispatch and direct-engine mode routing
- persisted ref-lock/report readers and migration/decoder
- release/docs and reconciliation tests

## Testing

Use pre-migration persisted state, live lock-loss, drift, exit, and canonical bridge behavior controls.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `reconcile` and `reconcile-check` are absent from CLI registration, direct-engine modes, docs, and help.
- [ ] Existing persisted reconcile-check state is migrated or decoded safely without reintroducing legacy command vocabulary.
- [ ] Live lock-loss rescheduling, snapshot drift, canonical bridge exit 0, and store RebaseGuard exit 75 remain unchanged.
- [ ] Canonical bridge operations cover the migrated diagnostics and focused migration/exit tests pass.
data.title: Remove legacy reconcile CLI, direct-engine modes, and persisted state
